findings.documented: API key should be appended as a query parameter (?api_key=...)
findings.actual: API key must be sent in the X-API-Key request header.
findings.how_found: Made a GET request with query parameter and received 401 detail error.

findings.documented: Returns a 'token', expires in 86400 (24h), no refresh flow.
findings.actual: Returns 'access_token', expires in 900 (15m), and includes a refresh_token flow.
findings.how_found: Inspected the successful login response body.
findings.impact: Users will be logged out after 15 minutes unless refresh flow is implemented.

findings.actual: Uses 'limit' and 'offset', and returns a 'has_more' boolean instead of exact pagination metadata.
findings.how_found: Inspected the response wrapper of a valid API call.
findings.impact: Standard page-based routing will fail to fetch subsequent data.

findings.documented: Returns active sale listings. Inactive listings are excluded server side.
findings.actual: Returns all listings. Many records have 'is_live: false'.
findings.how_found: Found multiple records in the results with is_live set to false.
findings.impact: Frontend will display unavailable properties unless filtered client-side.

findings.documented: Timestamps use UTC with a 'Z' suffix.
findings.actual: Timestamps use an explicit +05:30 offset (IST) or are naive datetime strings.
findings.impact: Dates parsed in the UI will be off by 5.5 hours.

findings.documented: price_min and price_max are in rupees.
findings.actual: price_min and price_max are in Crores.
findings.how_found: Found the highest price_max to be 12.44, which implies Crores, not Rupees.
findings.impact: UI will display prices that look drastically low to users.

findings.documented: Each listing corresponds to exactly one physical property.
findings.actual: Multiple listings describe the exact same physical property (same building, floor, carpet area).
findings.how_found: Grouped listings by physical attributes and found fewer unique properties than total listings.
findings.impact: Analytics and counts will over-represent actual housing supply.
